basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 27-year-old barista from Ljubljana, Slovenia, with a passion for knitting and Pokémon Go. When I'm not brewing up the perfect latte, you can find me exploring new parks with my Pokemon Go friends or working on my latest knitting project. I'm currently single and love meeting new people through my interests. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CET. I dream of achieving financial independence and often explore the FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) movement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive background in coffee brewing techniques, which I gained through my work as a barista at Starbucks. Additionally, I've taught myself the basics of personal finance and investing, particularly in the context of the FIRE movement. My interest in knitting is purely self-taught, fueled by online tutorials and community forums.
